notes: Ordered URL feature vector shared by the C++/WASM extractor, the Python training code and the extension. Changing order or meaning requires bumping 'version' and retraining. 'unknown' means the value used when the input is not available.

url_features.name: num_subdomains
url_features.desc: Labels to the left of the registered domain

url_features.name: suspicious_token_count
url_features.desc: Distinct suspicious tokens found in the lower-cased URL

url_features.name: is_punycode
url_features.desc: Any host label starts with xn--

url_features.name: is_mixed_script
url_features.desc: A decoded host label mixes letters from more than one script

url_features.name: is_ip_host
url_features.desc: Host is an IPv4 or bracketed IPv6 literal

url_features.name: brand_in_host_not_official
url_features.desc: A brand token appears in the host but the registered domain is not an official domain of that brand

url_features.name: brand_in_path
url_features.desc: A brand token appears in path/query while the host is not official for that brand

url_features.name: min_brand_edit_distance
url_features.desc: Smallest edit distance (0-2) between a host label part and a brand token, 3 if none within 2, 3 if host is official

url_features.name: homoglyph_brand_match
url_features.desc: Skeleton of the host matches a brand token but the raw host does not, and the host is not official
